tool_input.description: Get project context and existing feature groups

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission .tmp; cat > .tmp/ingest.py <<'PY'
import hopsworks, pandas as pd
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
df = pd.read_csv("data/prediction_log.csv")
df["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(df["ts"], utc=True)
df = df.sort_values("ts").reset_index(drop=True)
df["id"] = df.index.astype("int64")
df["prediction"] = df["prediction"].astype("double") if hasattr(df["prediction"],"astype") else df["prediction"]
df["prediction"] = df["prediction"].astype(float)
print("rows", len(df), "range", df.ts.min(), df.ts.max())
fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="prediction_log", version=1,
    primary_key=["id"], event_time="ts",
    online_enabled=False,
    description="Deployed model logged predictions (ts, prediction)",
)
fg.insert(df, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})
print("INSERT_DONE id", fg.id)
PY
python .tmp/ingest.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|pip install|compatibility" | tail -40
